# Mauricio Moya

> Finance leader with an MBA and AI agent engineer. Builds the systems that run finance: FP&A, budgeting and forecasting, cash flow, receivables, funding strategy, internal controls and grant compliance, plus the automation, dashboards and AI agents that cut cost and manual work. Twenty years in finance, operations and software. Open to roles and consulting.

Skills: FP&A, budgeting, forecasting, cash flow, accounts receivable, funding strategy, internal controls, audit readiness, grant compliance, finance automation, AI agents, agent skills for Claude Code, evals, Python, SQL, Excel, Power BI, Tableau, ERP systems, dashboards, data analysis, SaaS, university teaching.

Contact: LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/mba-mmoyat/ (the best way to reach him about roles, consulting or products).
